scenarios.title: Pinch only with the declared cover
scenarios.objective: Evaluate a pinch under an explicitly stated cover assignment.
scenarios.briefing: Navy uses a drill rule: YOU may pinch the puck-side wall only while F3 covers your high position. F1 contests Gold 1’s rim; F3 is currently closer to Gold’s net than the puck, so the named cover is not established. Navy attacks Gold’s net and defends Navy’s net. This is a selected-player teaching view; no movement is implied unless stated.
